name: Rindou Hanami
source:
A beautiful girl with an athletic figure. Gifted both physically and academically, she never lets it go to her head.

She's very honest, so she can come off as blunt, but she's actually really kind and caring.

Not long ago, after transferring to their class, she became friends with [url=/c23152]Alice[/url] and [url=/c24086]Yuuki[/url].

[Based on the [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet_pro/dasaku/character03.html]official description[/url]]
